title: Handley Page Halifax LL356
memorial_details: Black painted wooden bench with brass plaque.
inscription: The seat is dedicated to the honoured memory of seven Commonwealth airmen/ the crew of Halifax LL356, No. 138 (SD) Squadron RAF Tempsford/ which disappeared on Special Duties Air Operations into Belgium/ on the night of 27th/28th April , 1944/ names (7)/ Their Name Liveth Forever More
